settings.enable_box_help: Prints load each filament from its Box slot, including prints started from Fluidd or a slicer. Off, every print uses the external spool.
settings.auto_read_rfid_help: When filament is inserted, the Box reads its filament information, which takes about 20 seconds.
settings.auto_init_detect_help: On every startup, the Box reads the filament information of every slot, which takes about 1 minute.
settings.auto_reload_detect_help: When filament runs out, the Box switches to a slot with the same filament, vendor, and color.
settings.vo_box_spool_roll_help: While the Box heater is on, including during a print, each empty slot turns its spool every 5 minutes. Slots with filament fed never turn.
settings.no_reload_groups: No loaded slots share the same filament, vendor, and color, so none can stand in for another.

tag.title: Write {{slot}}’s spool tag
tag.intro: Put what’s on this spool on its RFID tag. The Box then sets the slot from the tag whenever the spool is loaded, here or in any Box slot.
tag.colors: Colors · up to four for a multicolor spool
tag.turns_hint: The Box turns the spool backward until its tag comes past the reader, about one turn at most. The tag must be on the side of the spool facing the reader. Only blank tags and tags Valve Oil wrote before are written.
tag.hand_hint: Filament is fed from this slot, so the Box can’t turn the spool. Once you start, turn it slowly backward by hand for up to a minute. The tag must be on the side of the spool facing the reader. Only blank tags and tags Valve Oil wrote before are written.
tag.turning: Turning the spool to find its tag…
tag.by_hand: Turn the spool slowly backward by hand…
tag.lost: The tag moved away before it could be written; trying again as it comes past.
tag.done: Tag written and checked. Whenever this spool is loaded into a Box slot, the slot is set to {{filament}}.
tag.not_found: No tag came past the reader. The Box reads a tag only on the side of the spool facing the reader. If the tag is on the other side, turn the spool over and try again.
tag.not_verified: The tag didn’t read back as written; it may have moved away mid-write.
tag.refusal_brand: It holds {{brand}} data, which the Box already reads. Valve Oil writes only blank tags and tags it wrote before.
tag.refusal_bambu: It’s a Bambu Lab tag, which the Box already reads. Bambu tags can’t be rewritten.
tag.refusal_locked: The tag is locked against writing.
tag.refusal_unsupported: The Box can’t write this kind of tag. Use a MIFARE Classic 1K or NTAG213, 215, or 216 tag.
tag.refusal_unknown: The tag holds data Valve Oil doesn’t write over.
